name: Testimonials
description: Dynamic, database-backed testimonials with moderation (pending/approved) and an optional public submission form. Ships the Verso block "Testimonials" (carousel or grid) that pulls approved testimonials live from the database — unlike the core static "Testimonial" block, which is a single testimonial typed directly in the editor.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read testimonials for the admin moderation list and the public display block.
Create the testimonials table and insert/update/delete testimonials (admin CRUD, approvals, public submissions).
Read the plugin settings (whether public submissions are allowed).
Save the plugin settings (toggle public submissions).
Expose admin CRUD/moderation routes and the public list/submit endpoints the Puck block consumes.
Add the Testimonios entry to the admin sidebar.
